mechanisms.name: Neighbor context
mechanisms.description: Native PLS-LDA sees a group mean and its contrast to physically shared-boundary-weighted neighbors.

mechanisms.name: Orthogonal nuisance separation
mechanisms.description: Native OPLS removes predictor variation orthogonal to the supervised response before class discrimination.

mechanisms.name: Latent density fusion
mechanisms.description: Fuse class evidence with shrinkage densities in supervised native PLS coordinates.

mechanisms.name: Covariance geometry
mechanisms.description: Log-Euclidean covariance of training-only label-free token coordinates, combined with group mean. Models correlated within-group heterogeneity rather than only channel SD.

mechanisms.name: Coded residual
mechanisms.description: Fit redundant error-correcting class-code residuals through a native PLS stage.
